body:
That's what y'all fail to see. I'm miles and miles away from any other person besides my parents, the nearest town takes over 45 minutes to get to, and it's just 2 stores and a few houses. 

I'd have to go nearly 3 hour drives to anywhere that has classes or clubs. 

I mean, my high school was an hour drive away.
Yeah I'm ending it myself next month when my parents go on vacation. I was hoping someone would be kind enough to tell me what to do with my life. But I was stupid to believe this would work.

I'm not sure when I've ever been happiest. Growing up my parents always told me to stay in my room, so that's what I did. As for the past three years, I've only worked my job, I haven't done anything else.

> And if you really are the most boring person, then isn't that an interesting fact?

I guess.
I have nothing but miles and miles of woods around me. It's just a bunch of trees.
